name: Bundle-aware Spend & Save $ settings
description: Configure bundle simulation and spend-and-save fixed dollar tiers
title: Bundle-aware Spend & Save $
helpText: Simulate collection-pair bundles for min-spend eligibility, then split a fixed $ off across eligible units that did not form a pair.
bundleHelpText: Must match the live collection-pair / hoodie bundle discount settings so artificial spend stays accurate.
noMarkets: No markets found for this store.
singlePriceNote: Any two products from the collection are treated as a fixed total in your store currency when calculating artificial spend. Discount is split proportionally by each product's price.
marketsPriceNote: Enable markets individually. Pair totals use that market's fixed price when calculating artificial spend.
eligibleCollectionHelp: Products that can receive the fixed $ off. Leave empty to allow all products. Units that formed a simulated pair never receive the discount. The unlocked $ is split proportionally across eligible non-paired units.
spendSaveFixedCsvHelp: Shop-currency spend|dollars-off pairs, comma-separated. Example: 75|15,150|40,200|60. Highest unlocked tier wins.
discountMessageHelp: Shown on discounted lines. Use [discountAmount] for the unlocked $ amount, e.g. Spend & Save $[discountAmount].
error: Unable to save settings. Please try again.
